adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return `nil` for an unknown/stale id, and the next line `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` inside `save_host`, raising `NoMethodError`. Similarly, `#destroy` does `host = ...first` then `host.destroy`, which will also raise on `nil`. Additionally, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` exists (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]`), so missing params would also 500. This behavior is directly verifiable from the diff.
